purpose: Technical/numerical verification of structural calculation evidence before professional review.

verification_levels.CALCULATED_UNVERIFIED: Primary solver completed; no independent technical verification claim.
verification_levels.TECHNICALLY_VERIFIED: All required technical checks passed, but no passing SCIA/CalculiX second-solver comparison was required/performed.
verification_levels.TECHNICALLY_CROSS_VERIFIED: All required technical checks passed and required SCIA/CalculiX second-solver comparisons passed.
verification_levels.PROFESSIONALLY_REVIEWED: Outside this engine; requires controlled professional review.
